dogecoin.text:
Just ordered a L9 Litecoin/Dogecoin miner.

One single miner in my garage will offset my entire power bill for the year at home.

Free electricity. Free Tesla charging at home. Free A/C.

Plug it in. Earn. Now only if I could get a new 400a electric panel installed!

What is the real reason Litecoin was merge mined with Dogecoin, which just happened to be pushed by the most famous man in the world?

I have a theory $doge was part of the litecoin suppression plan so that insiders could pack their litecoin bags cheap.

Just a hunch.
